Memories of your past linger heavily—HALP was suddenly teleported to a fantasy realm. He helped that world's "main character" w... 

Cold mountain wind sweeps across the crag, carrying the acrid smell of burnt pitch and wet granite. Ahead, half-concealed beneath the crumbling stone archway of a forgotten Netherese excavation, two hobgoblin scouts clad in banded mail examine a shattered warding stone with iron lanterns. One of them snarls in Goblin and raises a barbed spear as a stray pebble rolls beneath your boot.

Behind you lies the steep, mud-choked descent to the Trade Way. What do you do?
